SecurityEventContent.title: SecurityEventContent
SecurityEventContent.description: Immutable content of one security lifecycle event (the W010 event shape): stream, sequence, tenant scope, principal actor, causal parent, namespaced payload, producer-supplied instant.

SecurityStreamId.title: SecurityStreamId
SecurityStreamId.description: Opaque security-stream identity: "stream:security-<suffix>" (one stream per observed subject).

SecurityEventSequence.title: SecurityEventSequence
SecurityEventSequence.description: One security-event sequence number: 1-based, contiguous per security stream.

ObservabilityTenantId.title: ObservabilityTenantId
ObservabilityTenantId.description: Opaque tenant identity of the security domain: "tenant:<slug>" (the W009 grammar).

ObservabilityPrincipalId.title: ObservabilityPrincipalId
ObservabilityPrincipalId.description: Opaque acting principal of the security domain: "principal:<slug>" (the W009 grammar).

SecurityCausalParent.title: SecurityCausalParent
SecurityCausalParent.description: Causal parent of a security event: a logged event in any stream (the W010 shape; same-stream parents must be strictly earlier).

SecurityEventPayload.title: SecurityEventPayload
SecurityEventPayload.description: Typed event payload of a security event: namespaced discriminator plus opaque JSON data (the W010 shape).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).
